scope: Additive Henchmen Puppet L1-18 and spawned Henchmen L1-7 audit for permanent Minion Prince Equipment.
game_version: Official November 2024 Minion Prince release and November 2025 TH18 balance; dated secondary client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: THE TOWN HALL 17 UPDATE IS HERE!
facts: Minion Prince is a permanent flying Home Village Hero.
sources.limitations: This release page does not publish Henchmen Puppet or child stat and timing details.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
facts: Defensive Minion Prince HP was reduced by 1000 and all his Equipment gained an additional 500 HP.
sources.limitations: The note does not define offensive HP stacking, summon behavior or tick order.

sources.title: Town Hall 17 is here!
facts: Henchmen Puppet is default Minion Prince Equipment; activation spawns flying bodyguards.
sources.limitations: No current child stats, spawn coordinates, invisibility target-loss or tick timing are supplied.

sources.title: Henchmen Puppet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The public Minion Prince DPS 33-188 and constant HP bonus 500 table matches the pinned raw payload at all 18 levels; the page identifies a flying bodyguard summon.
sources.limitations: The table does not publish child level, child combat values, recovery bonus or one-second invisibility.

sources.title: Pinned Henchmen Puppet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned payload identifies Active Minion Prince Equipment, two Henchmen, one-second invisibility, L1-7 child mapping, and per-level DPS, recovery and HP bonuses.
sources.limitations: No child stat record, spawn location or phase ordering is supplied.

sources.title: Henchmen Puppet/Henchmen
facts: The page reports seven child levels, flying behavior and a historical seven-row HP/DPS table.
sources.limitations: Page revision and game build are not pinned, so the table is not accepted as current deterministic child data.

observations.note: Historical Equipment fields; only the hero DPS/HP table has a dated current-build cross-check.
Two named flying children belong to the permanent summon. Current HP, damage, speed, collision and target AI require further evidence.

derivations.result: Retain all 18 pinned levels as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check current dated DPS and +500 HP with the frozen raw payload, and keep child mapping, recovery and invisibility marked historical.

derivations.result: Add separate partial child coverage row
derivations.method: The pinned two-child level map and dated launch report identify a spawned flying unit; no unversioned child stat table is imported.

rejected_inferences.rule: Import the community Henchman L1-7 HP/DPS table as current
rejected_inferences.reason: Its game version and exact revision are not pinned or corroborated by a dated client extract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use ordinary Minion stats for Henchmen
rejected_inferences.reason: The child has a distinct name and seven-level mapping; no source establishes ordinary Minion inheritance.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn two Henchmen at the Prince's location on activation tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The source does not specify geometry, collision or entity-ID assignment order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply one-second invisibility to both Prince and Henchmen
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned field does not specify recipient, onset, target loss or expiry order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply HP recovery immediately on activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned bonus does not specify recovery phase or cap ordering.

one-second invisibility recipient and target-loss order
hero HP/DPS bonus stacking and recovery phase
summon command, spawn and attack tick order
Viewer controls, child art, snapshot, replay and RL activation
current child HP, DPS, cadence, range, movement, footprint and hitbox

conclusion: Henchmen Puppet L1-18 and its two spawned Henchmen L1-7 remain partial and catalogue-only. Equipment level bonuses and child identity are sourced, while current child combat and activation timing remain unresolved.
